protocol.selection: Pre-noise structural control plus first two-step shorter/longer development fixtures. No held-out or general algorithm-improvement claim.
protocol.observable_failure: Any of n independent, complete basis-specific input-output logical correlation observables is misdecoded.
protocol.sampling_reuse: Reuse counts only for identical ideal/noisy circuit hashes, basis/distance/noise/decoder and shot conditions. Count each unique sample once.
protocol.timing_scope: Routing-only pass before compilation, Monte Carlo or decoder work; no other research job launched by this runner during timing. Host may be shared.

tqec_verification.method: pinned local Git tree and installed source byte comparison
